invariants: No system files, application classes, render contexts, CONFIG, Handlebars helpers/partials or Document data are changed.
No lib-wrapper or global monkeypatch is needed; only one synchronous render hook is installed.
No global text walker, substring dictionary replace, MutationObserver or HTML reserialization is used.
Only direct text-node nodeValue, explicitly allowlisted aria-label, and the authorized exact characteristic-chip data-tooltip display attributes are written; existing child nodes/listeners survive.

Input values, input names, textarea contents, formulas, placeholders, datalist/catalog entries, checked/selected state and all mechanical data-* attributes remain intact. The sole data-tooltip exception is independently asserted.
Only allowlisted select names and exact option value + English label pairs are eligible. Options without explicit value are skipped; unknown/homebrew options remain unchanged.
Document names, inventories, power names, rich descriptions, prose-mirror/editor content and Notes tabs are excluded.
Passes are idempotent. Scope/language mismatch returns inactive and makes no write. Installer is duplicate-safe and has dispose().
Linked native i18n keys are preferred for common labels so the module keeps terminology consistent.

intentionalExclusions.reason: Outside this UI-only phase; preserve source values and descriptions.
Formulas, canonical engine examples and data notation are kept exactly; literal UI S/Semi/Full buttons are separately translated.
Adapter only covers real Actor/Item sheet classes; native i18n can cover shared translated keys.
